$comment: Verbatim flag list from OCP, Red Flags for Integrity (2024). Committed so the alignment mappings in src/lib/riskFlagCatalog.ts can be re-verified by a TEST rather than by re-reading a 2 MB PDF — which is what let three false supporting claims survive a green suite. Update only by re-extracting from the published source below.
method: pdftotext -layout (the mode that separates the two-column Definition / rationale tables), merged with the plain-mode extraction for the summary listing.

flags.R003: The submission period is too short
flags.R004: Failure to adequately advertise the request for bids
flags.R005: Key tender information and documents are not available
flags.R009: Buyer increases the cost of the bidding documents
flags.R010: Unjustified use of non competitive procedure
flags.R011: Splitting purchases to avoid procurement thresholds
flags.R012: Direct awards in contravention to the provisions of the procurement plan
flags.R013: High use of non competitive methods
flags.R014: Short time between tender advertising and bid opening
flags.R015: Long time between bid opening and bid evaluation
flags.R016: Tender value is higher or lower than average for this item category
flags.R017: Unreasonably low or high line item
flags.R019: Low number of bidders for item category
flags.R021: High use of discretionary evaluation criteria
flags.R029: Bid prices deviate from Benford’s Law
flags.R031: Winning bid price very close or higher than estimated price
flags.R041: Physical similarities in documents by different bidders
flags.R042: Bidder has abnormal address or phone number
flags.R043: Bidder has same contact information as project official
flags.R045: Bidder is not listed in business registries
flags.R046: Bidder is debarred or on sanctions list
flags.R047: Supplier is not traceable on the web
flags.R052: Small initial purchase from supplier followed by much larger purchases
flags.R053: Co-bidding pairs have same recurrent winner
flags.R054: Direct award followed by change orders that exceed the competitive threshold
flags.R055: Multiple direct awards above or just below competitive threshold
flags.R056: Winning bid does not meet the award criteria
flags.R059: Large difference between the award value and final contract amount
flags.R060: Long time between award date and contract signature date
flags.R065: Contract amendments to reduce line items
flags.R066: Contract amendments to increase line items
flags.R070: Losing bidders are hired as subcontractors
flags.R071: A contractor subcontracts all or most of the work received
flags.R073: Discrepancies between work completed and contract specifications
